chunks.title: 【英语二】小作文大纲档次详细描述：第五档（最高档） (9-10分)
chunks.content:
【英语二 小作文大纲详细档次描述：第五档（最高档） (9-10分)】
总体描述：很好地完成了试题规定的任务。包含所有内容要点；使用丰富的语法结构和词汇；语言自然流畅，仅有极个别笔误或小错；有效地使用语句间衔接手段；格式和语域完全符合要求。
分项细则：
- content: 完全切题，所有要点（2-3个）全面覆盖，展开充分合理，无无关信息。
- organization: 全文行文流畅，段落逻辑清晰，恰当使用衔接词和过渡句，结构严谨。
- vocabulary: 词汇使用丰富多样，用词准确得体，体现词汇广度，无中式英语。
- grammar: 语法结构复杂多样（复合句、非谓语、从句），偶尔出现不影响理解的小瑕疵。
- format_register: 书信/通知等格式完全规范（称呼、正文缩进/顶格、落款、日期），语域（正式/非正式）极得体。
典型特征：
- 词数在100-130词之间，字迹工整
- 使用2种以上复杂句型（如倒装、虚拟语气、定语从句等）
- 准确使用主题相关的高级词汇与短语

chunks.title: 【英语二】小作文大纲档次详细描述：第四档 (7-8分)
chunks.content:
【英语二 小作文大纲详细档次描述：第四档 (7-8分)】
总体描述：较好地完成了试题规定的任务。包含所有或大部分内容要点；使用较丰富的语法结构和词汇；语言有少量错误但不影响意义表达；使用适当的衔接手段；格式和语域基本符合要求。
分项细则：
- content: 切题，主要要点均已覆盖，内容较充实，展开基本合理。
- organization: 层次较分明，逻辑连贯，运用基本的衔接手段将全文组织起来。
- vocabulary: 具备一定的词汇量，用词基本恰当，偶有搭配不当或轻微拼写错误。
- grammar: 语法结构较有变化，能够运用简单复句，存在少量语法错误但不影响理解。
- format_register: 格式基本符合要求，称呼与署名规范，语域基本适宜。
典型特征：
- 词数达到要求（通常100词左右）
- 以简单复合句为主，夹杂少量亮点句式
- 个别轻微拼写或介词搭配错误

chunks.title: 【英语二】小作文大纲档次详细描述：第三档 (5-6分)
chunks.content:
【英语二 小作文大纲详细档次描述：第三档 (5-6分)】
总体描述：基本完成了试题规定的任务。虽漏掉一些内容，但包含主要内容；应用的语法结构和词汇能满足任务需求；有一些语言错误，但基本不影响理解；应用简单的衔接手段；格式和语域大体符合要求。
分项细则：
- content: 基本切题，覆盖主要要点，但可能遗漏次要要点或展开不充分。
- organization: 基本分段，结构较散漫，衔接词使用单一或机械（如过度使用First, Second, Third）。
- vocabulary: 词汇贫乏单调，反复使用基础词汇（如good, important, very），有中式表达。
- grammar: 句式单一，以简单句为主；存在较多时态、主谓一致、单复数等基础语法错误。
- format_register: 格式略有瑕疵（如称呼未换行、标点缺失），语域把握一般。
典型特征：
- 字数在80-100词左右，略有不足或勉强达标
- 常见语法错误频繁（如he go, many peoples）
- 内容展开平淡，模板痕迹明显

chunks.title: 【英语二】小作文大纲档次详细描述：第二档 (3-4分)
chunks.content:
【英语二 小作文大纲详细档次描述：第二档 (3-4分)】
总体描述：未能按要求完成试题规定的任务。漏掉或未理解主要内容，或写了无关内容；语法结构和词汇非常有限；语言错误较多且严重影响理解；缺乏语句衔接；格式和语域不符合要求。
分项细则：
- content: 偏题或要点大面积遗漏，大部分内容与题意关联较弱。
- organization: 缺乏合理分段或逻辑组织混乱，前后句子缺乏逻辑关联。
- vocabulary: 词汇量严重匮乏，拼写错误大量出现，词不达意。
- grammar: 语法错误频发，大量句子结构破碎（残缺句、逗号连接句、乱用从句）。
- format_register: 严重忽视格式要求，称呼署名缺失或错位。
典型特征：
- 字数严重不足（低于70词）
- 通篇大量语法与拼写严重错误，阅读费力
- 存在生硬拼凑或照抄阅读材料句子

chunks.title: 【英语二】小作文大纲档次详细描述：第一档 (1-2分)
chunks.content:
【英语二 小作文大纲详细档次描述：第一档 (1-2分)】
总体描述：未完成试题规定的任务。明显遗漏主要内容，写了大量无关内容；语法结构和词汇极为贫乏；语言错误严重影响理解，只有个别词句可读；缺乏任何组织结构。
分项细则：
- content: 严重跑题，仅写出少量零星与主题相关的词汇。
- organization: 无逻辑可言，不成篇章。
- vocabulary: 只有零星单词拼凑，甚至出现中文或拼音。
- grammar: 完全没有正确的句子结构。
- format_register: 完全不具备应用文格式。
典型特征：
- 字数极少（不足40词）
- 仅有零星词组，无法形成完整句意

chunks.title: 【英语二】小作文大纲档次详细描述：零分 (0分)
chunks.content:
【英语二 小作文大纲详细档次描述：零分 (0分)】
总体描述：所传达的信息或所用语言太少，无法评价；内容与试题无关；完全抄袭试题材料或阅读理解；未作答或使用中文作答。
分项细则：
- content: 白卷、完全跑题、完全抄写阅读材料原文。
- organization: 无。
- vocabulary: 无或完全抄袭。
- grammar: 无。
- format_register: 无。
典型特征：
- 未作答、照抄阅读材料2句以上、纯中文书写

chunks.title: 【英语二】大作文大纲档次详细描述：第五档（最高档） (13-15分)
chunks.content:
【英语二 大作文大纲详细档次描述：第五档（最高档） (13-15分)】
总体描述：很好地完成了试题规定的任务。包含所有图表要点及引申讨论；使用丰富的语法结构和词汇；语言自然流畅，仅有极个别笔误或小错；有效地使用衔接手段，文字连贯，层次分明；全文结构完整严谨。
分项细则：
- content: 图表解读精准，数据归纳提炼恰当，原因分析深入透彻且多角度，结论/建议具有前瞻性与深度。
- organization: 标准三段式结构完整（描述-阐释-总结），段落逻辑严密，论证有力，过渡词与衔接手段多样自然。
- vocabulary: 高级词汇与图表专业术语运用自如，词义精准，词汇搭配地道，极具学术感与说服力。
- grammar: 长短句结合，熟练运用从句、非谓语动词、分词状语、倒装或虚拟结构等复杂句式，几乎无错误。
- word_count: 150-180词，字迹工整清晰。
典型特征：
- 不机械列举所有数据，而是抓主次、比差异、归纳趋势
- 原因分析从经济、社会、心理、科技等多维度切入
- 句式极具节奏感，没有中式思维痕迹

chunks.title: 【英语二】大作文大纲档次详细描述：第四档 (9-12分)
chunks.content:
【英语二 大作文大纲详细档次描述：第四档 (9-12分)】
总体描述：较好地完成了试题规定的任务。包含图表主要信息和讨论要点；使用较丰富的语法结构和词汇；语言有少量错误但不影响意义表达；使用适当的衔接手段，层次较分明；结构基本严密完整。
分项细则：
- content: 图表描述基本准确，核心数据提及；原因分析合理，论点成立；有明确结论或建议。
- organization: 三段式结构清晰，各段分工明确，衔接词使用正常，段落内部有一定展开。
- vocabulary: 词汇量足够表达思想，能使用图表变化常用词汇，有少量选词不当或拼写小错。
- grammar: 句式有一定复杂度，能够正确使用主从复合句，少量语法错误（如个别单复数、冠词）。
- word_count: 140-160词左右，达到规定字数。
典型特征：
- 数据描述清晰完整，但可能略微倾向于平铺直叙
- 原因分析清晰但论证深度中等
- 偶有套用通用模板痕迹，但结合题目紧密

chunks.title: 【英语二】大作文大纲档次详细描述：第三档 (5-8分)
chunks.content:
【英语二 大作文大纲详细档次描述：第三档 (5-8分)】
总体描述：基本完成了试题规定的任务。漏掉部分图表信息或分析浮于表面；应用的语法结构和词汇能满足任务需求；有一些语言错误，但基本不影响理解；应用简单的衔接手段；结构大体完整。
分项细则：
- content: 能看出图表主题，但数据描述不完整或有小误读；原因分析空泛单薄，论证无力；尾段草草收尾。
- organization: 段落划分存在但逻辑散漫，衔接手段机械单一，段落之间或句间跳跃。
- vocabulary: 词汇贫乏，反复使用基础词汇（如people, things, good, make），中式直译较多。
- grammar: 句式简单单调，多次出现时态混乱、主谓不一致、语态错误等常见语法问题。
- word_count: 120-140词左右，略显单薄。
典型特征：
- 图表数据解读有误或只字不提具体数值
- 模板化严重，空话套话占比较高
- 语言表达带有浓厚中式英语色彩

chunks.title: 【英语二】大作文大纲档次详细描述：第二档 (1-4分)
chunks.content:
【英语二 大作文大纲详细档次描述：第二档 (1-4分)】
总体描述：未能按要求完成试题规定的任务。严重误读图表或脱离主题；语法结构和词汇非常有限；语言错误较多且严重影响理解；缺乏语句衔接，内容混乱；结构残缺不全。
分项细则：
- content: 严重曲解图表趋势或完全偏离图表主题，无有效分析。
- organization: 结构混乱，段落不分或胡乱分段，无逻辑推导过程。
- vocabulary: 词汇极其匮乏，拼写错误累累，无法准确传达语义。
- grammar: 严重语法错误连篇，碎片化断句，大量病句导致难以阅读。
- word_count: 不足100词。
典型特征：
- 看不出图表在讲什么，或者完全看反趋势
- 通篇大量不可理解的病句
- 拼凑生搬硬套的模板背诵句

chunks.title: 【英语二】大作文大纲档次详细描述：第一档 (0分)
chunks.content:
【英语二 大作文大纲详细档次描述：第一档 (0分)】
总体描述：未作答、完全偏题、全篇照抄阅读理解、字数不足30词或使用中文。
分项细则：
- content: 白卷、完全抄题、完全跑题。
- organization: 无。
- vocabulary: 无。
- grammar: 无。
- word_count: 0-30词。
典型特征：
- 直接抄写考卷上的阅读理解材料、只有两行中文

chunks.title: 【英语二】大作文评分维度：图表描述准确性（满分15分）
chunks.content:
【英语二 大作文评分维度 - 图表描述准确性】
满分权重：核心维度（大作文特有）
描述：是否准确解读图表数据和趋势
考察要点：
- 数据引用是否准确
- 趋势描述是否正确（上升/下降/波动/稳定）
- 是否抓住了图表的主要特征
- 比较和对比是否合理
- 是否避免了过度推断

chunks.title: 【英语二】大作文评分维度：内容完整性（满分15分）
chunks.content:
【英语二 大作文评分维度 - 内容完整性】
满分权重：核心维度
描述：描述、分析、总结三部分是否完整
考察要点：
- 是否有图表描述段
- 是否有原因分析或深入讨论段
- 是否有总结或建议段
- 各部分内容是否充实
- 内容是否与图表主题紧密相关

chunks.title: 【英语二】大作文评分维度：组织连贯性（满分15分）
chunks.content:
【英语二 大作文评分维度 - 组织连贯性】
满分权重：重要维度
描述：文章结构是否清晰，逻辑是否通顺
考察要点：
- 是否有清晰的三段式结构
- 段落之间过渡是否自然
- 句子之间衔接是否连贯
- 论述逻辑是否清晰
- 主题句是否明确

chunks.title: 【英语二】大作文评分维度：语言质量（满分15分）
chunks.content:
【英语二 大作文评分维度 - 语言质量】
满分权重：核心维度
描述：词汇多样性、句式复杂度、语法准确性的综合评价
考察要点：
- 词汇是否丰富多样
- 是否使用了图表描述的专用词汇
- 句式是否有变化（简单句与复杂句搭配）
- 语法错误的数量和严重程度
- 拼写和标点是否正确
- 是否存在中式英语

chunks.title: 【英语二】大作文评分维度：任务完成度（满分15分）
chunks.content:
【英语二 大作文评分维度 - 任务完成度】
满分权重：基础维度
描述：是否满足题目对写作任务的各项要求
考察要点：
- 字数是否达到要求（150词以上）
- 是否按照题目要求完成了描述和分析
- 是否回应了题目中的specific instructions
- 是否在合理时间和篇幅内完成

chunks.title: 【英语一】小作文大纲档次详细描述：第五档（高分档） (9-10分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 小作文大纲详细档次描述：第五档（高分档） (9-10分)】
总体描述：很好地完成了试题任务。包含所有内容要点；语言丰富流畅；格式与语域完全符合应用文规范；仅有极个别笔误。
分项细则：
- content: 题目要求的所有要点全部覆盖并充分展开，信息合理充实。
- organization: 段落清晰（标准三段），过渡自然，首尾呼应。
- vocabulary: 词汇丰富得体，符合公文或书信礼仪。
- grammar: 语法准确，句式有适度变化。
- format_register: 称呼、署名、通知标题、排版规范，语域高度得体。
典型特征：
- 词数100-130词
- 书信/通知格式完美
- 无明显语法失误

chunks.title: 【英语一】小作文大纲档次详细描述：第四档（良好档） (7-8分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 小作文大纲详细档次描述：第四档（良好档） (7-8分)】
总体描述：较好地完成了试题任务。包含主要要点；语言基本准确，有少量小错但不影响理解；格式与语域基本符合要求。
分项细则：
- content: 覆盖所有或主要要点，展开基本合理。
- organization: 段落清楚，行文较顺畅。
- vocabulary: 词汇满足表达需要，用词基本恰当。
- grammar: 语法较准确，偶有少量失误。
- format_register: 格式基本合规，称呼落款齐备。
典型特征：
- 词数90-110词
- 格式完整

chunks.title: 【英语一】小作文大纲档次详细描述：第三档（及格档） (5-6分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 小作文大纲详细档次描述：第三档（及格档） (5-6分)】
总体描述：基本完成了试题任务。虽漏掉一些内容，但包含主要要点；语法和词汇能满足基本需求，但错误较多；格式有小瑕疵。
分项细则：
- content: 遗漏部分次要要点或阐述过简。
- organization: 结构稍散，衔接简单。
- vocabulary: 词汇简单，有中式表达。
- grammar: 语法错误较多（时态、单复数）。
- format_register: 格式略有瑕疵（漏标点、署名不对）。
典型特征：
- 词数80-90词左右
- 格式偶有小错

chunks.title: 【英语一】小作文大纲档次详细描述：第二档（不及格档） (3-4分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 小作文大纲详细档次描述：第二档（不及格档） (3-4分)】
总体描述：未能按要求完成任务。严重漏掉要点；语言错误严重影响理解；格式严重错误。
分项细则：
- content: 严重漏要点或偏题。
- organization: 无清晰分段，逻辑断裂。
- vocabulary: 用词不当，错误连篇。
- grammar: 病句繁多，严重影响理解。
- format_register: 格式缺失（无称呼/署名）。
典型特征：
- 词数不足70词

chunks.title: 【英语一】小作文大纲档次详细描述：第一档（极低分档） (1-2分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 小作文大纲详细档次描述：第一档（极低分档） (1-2分)】
总体描述：未完成任务。仅写出零散词句，不成篇章。
分项细则：
- content: 内容残缺。
- organization: 杂乱无章。
- vocabulary: 孤立词汇。
- grammar: 不成句。
典型特征：
- 词数不足40词

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文大纲档次详细描述：第五档（高分档） (17-20分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文大纲详细档次描述：第五档（高分档） (17-20分)】
总体描述：很好地完成了试题规定的任务。包含所有内容要点；使用丰富的语法结构和词汇；语言自然流畅，仅有极个别非关键小错；有效地使用语句间衔接手段；图画描述生动贴切，寓意揭示深刻入微；格式和语域完全符合要求。
分项细则：
- content: 精准捕捉并生动描绘图画所有核心要素与文字说明，开门见山点题；深层寓意提炼准确且深刻，多维度展开剖析，末段对策切实有力。
- organization: 层次极其分明，段落划分比例极佳，熟练使用多种过渡词句和衔接手法，行文浑然一体。
- vocabulary: 学术词汇量丰富且运用得体，体现词汇广度与深度，无生硬拼凑与中式英语。
- grammar: 能灵活熟练使用多种高级复杂语法结构（如非谓语动词、各类从句、倒装句、虚拟语气），语法错误极少甚至零失误。
- format_register: 完全符合论说文写作规范，行文客观辩证，语域庄重正式。
典型特征：
- 词数完全达标（180-220词最佳）
- 使用至少3种以上复杂句型（倒装、状语从句、分词伴随）
- 包含与图画主题紧密相关的高级主题词与地道短语
- 卷面清晰工整

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文大纲档次详细描述：第四档（良好档） (13-16分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文大纲详细档次描述：第四档（良好档） (13-16分)】
总体描述：较好地完成了试题规定的任务。包含大部分或全部内容要点；使用较丰富的语法结构和词汇；语言有少量错误但不影响意义表达；有效使用衔接手段；图画描述较清晰，寓意明确。
分项细则：
- content: 切题，描述包含主要图画特征，阐释了核心象征寓意，提出相应见解或建议，论证较充分。
- organization: 段落划分合理，逻辑清晰，行文较流畅，具备基本的过渡段句。
- vocabulary: 词汇量较充实，用词基本恰当，偶有搭配不当或个别拼写失误。
- grammar: 句式结构较有变化，能够运用复合句，存在少量语法小错（如单复数、冠词），但不影响整体理解。
- format_register: 符合议论文文体规范，语域大体得当。
典型特征：
- 词数达到大纲标准（160-190词）
- 以主从复合句为主，夹杂少量亮点句式
- 论证较为全面，逻辑较为顺畅

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文大纲档次详细描述：第三档（及格档） (9-12分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文大纲详细档次描述：第三档（及格档） (9-12分)】
总体描述：基本完成了试题规定的任务。虽漏掉一些内容，但包含主要要点；应用的语法结构和词汇能满足基本任务；有一些语言错误，但基本不影响理解；应用简单的衔接手段；图画描述略粗或寓意分析空泛。
分项细则：
- content: 基本切题，提到图画大致内容并试图阐释寓意，但描述简略或寓意流于表面，套话偏多，缺乏深入分析。
- organization: 段落基本成型，但逻辑松散，衔接词机械死板（重复使用First, Second, Third, What's more）。
- vocabulary: 词汇单一，反复使用初级词汇（good, bad, think, people, very），有中式表达。
- grammar: 以简单句为主，存在较多时态、主谓一致、介词搭配错误，复合句较少且容易出现句式瑕疵。
- format_register: 格式基本符合，但语气略欠成熟。
典型特征：
- 字数在140-160词左右，略显单薄
- 模板套用痕迹明显，个性化与针对性论述较少
- 基础语法错误较多

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文大纲档次详细描述：第二档（不及格档） (5-8分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文大纲详细档次描述：第二档（不及格档） (5-8分)】
总体描述：未能按要求完成任务。严重遗漏核心要点或偏离主题；对图画理解有误；词汇和语法错误严重影响理解；篇章缺乏连贯性。
分项细则：
- content: 严重偏题或误读图画寓意，描述与论证大面积脱节，通篇无关套话。
- organization: 缺乏合理段落划分，句际关系混乱，逻辑不通。
- vocabulary: 词汇极度贫乏，拼写错误密集，大量滥用词汇。
- grammar: 语法语病连篇，出现大量无谓语、双谓语等严重碎裂病句。
- format_register: 文不成篇。
典型特征：
- 词数不足（通常少于120词）
- 通篇病句阻碍阅读理解
- 跑题偏题

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文大纲档次详细描述：第一档（极低分档） (1-4分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文大纲详细档次描述：第一档（极低分档） (1-4分)】
总体描述：未完成试题规定的任务。严重偏离图画主题；仅写出零散断句或词汇拼凑；语言错误极其严重。
分项细则：
- content: 仅有零星词汇，无法传达任何有效信息。
- organization: 不成段落，无逻辑可言。
- vocabulary: 词汇极少，错误极多。
- grammar: 不成句子。
典型特征：
- 字数不足60词
- 无法阅读

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文评分维度：图画描述准确性与点题能力（满分20分）
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文评分维度 - 图画描述准确性与点题能力】
满分权重：核心维度（英语一大作文特有核心指标，满分5分）
描述：是否精准捕捉并生动描绘图画核心细节、人物动作、文字说明及反差
考察要点：
- 图画主体要素（人物、物体、场景）是否描写清晰
- 图画中的文字说明（caption）或关键文字线索是否准确译述
- 是否捕捉到了画面的讽刺、反差或象征对比
- 首段描写是否紧凑，有无泛泛套用万能空话
- 过渡句是否自然引申至中心寓意

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文评分维度：寓意阐释深刻性与论据充实度（满分20分）
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文评分维度 - 寓意阐释深刻性与论据充实度】
满分权重：核心维度（分值最高部分，满分6分）
描述：对漫画象征意义的理解是否深刻准确，原因分析与论述是否层次丰富
考察要点：
- 中心论点是否完全切中命题题旨，有无偏题或误读
- 是否从多个维度（心理、社会、科技、文化等）展开合理论述
- 论据与论点之间是否存在紧密的因果支撑链条
- 论述是否深刻辩证，避免空洞口号式说教
- 末段对策建议是否切实可行、有针对性

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文评分维度：语言质量与表达多样性（满分20分）
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文评分维度 - 语言质量与表达多样性】
满分权重：核心维度（满分5分）
描述：词汇丰富度、学术用词准确性、高级句型多样性及语法准确度
考察要点：
- 高级学术词汇与习语搭配的使用频次与地道度
- 复杂句式多样性（定语从句、名词性从句、倒装句、强调句、分词短语）
- 语法错误的数量与严重程度（动词时态、主谓一致、搭配、介词）
- 中式英语（Chinglish）的辨识与避免
- 拼写与标点规范

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文评分维度：篇章组织连贯性与逻辑衔接（满分20分）
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文评分维度 - 篇章组织连贯性与逻辑衔接】
满分权重：重要维度（满分4分）
描述：段落划分是否科学清晰，段内与段落间逻辑过渡词是否自然严密
考察要点：
- 标准三段式结构是否比例匀称（首段精炼、中段充实、尾段有力）
- 衔接词与过渡句是否丰富自然，避免机械罗列（如滥用First, Second）
- 指代关系（代词、同义替换）是否明确清晰
- 段首主题句与段尾小结是否呼应

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文评分档次：第五档（高分档） (17-20分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文评分档次 - 第五档（高分档） (17-20分)】
描述：很好地完成了试题规定的任务。包含所有内容要点；图画描述生动贴切，寓意阐释深刻全面；使用丰富的语法结构和词汇，表达自然流畅；行文逻辑严密，极少甚至无语法错误。
标准：
- 精准描绘图画核心细节与文字说明，点题迅速自然
- 中心思想极其明确，寓意阐释入木三分，论证充分有说服力
- 运用高级词汇与多种复杂句式（倒装、虚拟、分词等），语言极富感染力
- 衔接手段丰富地道，篇章连贯紧凑
- 词数完全符合要求（180-220词），卷面整洁美观

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文评分档次：第四档（良好档） (13-16分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文评分档次 - 第四档（良好档） (13-16分)】
描述：较好地完成了试题规定的任务。切题；包含图画主要内容并揭示寓意；论据较充分；使用较丰富的词汇和语法结构；行文逻辑较清晰，仅有少量非关键语言小错。
标准：
- 准确描述图画主要内容，成功揭示图画象征意义
- 原因分析或观点阐述较合理，论述基本展开
- 具备较好语言运用能力，虽偶有拼写或小语法瑕疵但不影响理解
- 段落结构清晰，衔接较为自然
- 词数达到大纲基本要求（160-200词）

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文评分档次：第三档（及格档） (9-12分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文评分档次 - 第三档（及格档） (9-12分)】
描述：基本完成了试题规定的任务。基本切题；图画描述不充分或寓意阐释浮于表面；论证内容相对单薄或套话较多；语法结构和词汇能满足基本任务，但错误较多。
标准：
- 图画描述过于简单或遗漏部分关键细节，寓意提炼欠精准
- 论述较空洞，机械套用万能模板痕迹明显
- 语言以简单句为主，存在较多时态、主谓一致、单复数等中低级语法错误
- 衔接手段单一生硬（反复使用 First, Second, Moreover）
- 字数略有欠缺（130-150词左右）

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文评分档次：第二档（不及格档） (5-8分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文评分档次 - 第二档（不及格档） (5-8分)】
描述：未能按要求完成任务。严重偏题或误读图画寓意；漏掉核心要点；语言错误密集且严重影响理解；结构混乱缺乏连贯性。
标准：
- 严重误读漫画内容或完全跑题
- 论点脱离图画，通篇为无关套话堆砌
- 语法错误频发，断句碎裂，中式英语严重阻碍阅读
- 词数严重不足（低于110词）

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文评分档次：第一档（极低分档） (1-4分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文评分档次 - 第一档（极低分档） (1-4分)】
描述：未完成试题规定的任务。严重偏离图画主题；仅写出零散断句或词汇拼凑；语言错误极其严重。
标准：
- 通篇仅写出少量与题目相关的孤立词汇
- 文章不成段落，无法表达完整语义
- 词数不足60词

chunks.title: 【英语一】大作文评分档次：零分档 (0分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 大作文评分档次 - 零分档 (0分)】
描述：白卷、完全跑题、纯中文作答、抄袭试卷阅读理解片段。
标准：
- 空白试卷未作答
- 完全抄写阅读理解或完形填空段落
- 使用中文书写正文

chunks.title: 【英语一】小作文评分维度：内容要点完整性（满分10分）
chunks.content:
【英语一 小作文评分维度 - 内容要点完整性】
满分权重：核心维度（满分3分）
描述：是否全面覆盖试题规定的全部要点（通常为2-3个要点），信息阐述是否充实
考察要点：
- 题目给出的核心任务要点是否全覆盖
- 要点是否有适当展开，信息是否合理充分
- 是否存在脱离主题的无关啰嗦
- 针对书信/通知中要求的特定信息（时间地点联系人等）是否交代清晰

chunks.title: 【英语一】小作文评分维度：格式规范与语域得体性（满分10分）
chunks.content:
【英语一 小作文评分维度 - 格式规范与语域得体性】
满分权重：核心维度（满分2分，小作文扣分重灾区）
描述：文体格式（称呼、落款、标题、排版）是否标准，语体风格（正式/半正式/亲切）是否得体
考察要点：
- 书信称呼（Dear...）与落款署名（Yours sincerely, Li Ming）是否规范
- 通知告示标题是否居中大写（NOTICE），落款发文单位是否得当
- 备忘录表头（TO/FROM/DATE/SUBJECT）是否齐备
- 语气与交际对象是否匹配（对教授/公文需正式礼貌，对朋友需亲切得体）
- 段落缩进与标点符号是否合规

chunks.title: 【英语一】小作文评分维度：语言准确性与基础表达（满分10分）
chunks.content:
【英语一 小作文评分维度 - 语言准确性与基础表达】
满分权重：核心维度（满分3分）
描述：语法、拼写、标点、用词及句子结构的准确度
考察要点：
- 动词时态与主谓单复数的一致性
- 介词与固定搭配使用是否准确
- 拼写与大小写规范
- 是否存在生硬的中式英语直译（Chinglish）
- 基础句式是否完整，有无碎片句或连写句

chunks.title: 【英语一】小作文评分维度：篇章连贯与逻辑组织（满分10分）
chunks.content:
【英语一 小作文评分维度 - 篇章连贯与逻辑组织】
满分权重：重要维度（满分2分）
描述：段落划分是否明晰，句子与段落之间衔接词使用是否得当
考察要点：
- 是否清晰分段（建议三段式）
- 衔接手段（First and foremost, In addition, In consequence等）是否自然
- 逻辑顺序是否清晰递进

chunks.title: 【英语一】小作文评分档次：第五档（高分档） (9-10分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 小作文评分档次 - 第五档（高分档） (9-10分)】
描述：很好地完成了试题规定的任务。包含所有内容要点；使用丰富的语法结构和词汇；语言自然流畅，仅有极个别笔误；格式与语域完全符合应用文规范。
标准：
- 要点全齐，展开生动合情合理
- 格式完全正确（称呼、落款、标点无误）
- 语域得体，用词精准高雅，句式有一定丰富度
- 字数在100-130词之间

chunks.title: 【英语一】小作文评分档次：第四档（良好档） (7-8分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 小作文评分档次 - 第四档（良好档） (7-8分)】
描述：较好地完成了试题规定的任务。包含大部分或全部内容要点；语言基本准确，偶有小错但不影响理解；格式与语域基本符合要求。
标准：
- 覆盖主要任务要点，内容基本充实
- 格式基本规范，称呼署名完整
- 存在个别语法或拼写瑕疵，但不影响整体沟通
- 行文较连贯

chunks.title: 【英语一】小作文评分档次：第三档（及格档） (5-6分)
chunks.content:
【英语一 小作文评分档次 - 第三档（及格档） (5-6分)】
描述：基本完成了试题规定的任务。虽漏掉部分内容，但包含主要要点；应用的语法和词汇能满足基本需求；有一些语言错误；格式有小瑕疵。
标准：
- 遗漏部分要点或展开不充分

The chart above delineates a remarkable upward trajectory in the possession of durable consumer goods among Chinese households from 2014 to 2023. As is vividly demonstrated by the data, the ownership of essential home appliances, particularly refrigerators and air conditioners, has experienced steady and sustained expansion over the past decade, with nearly every hundred households equipped with modern appliances.

The profound factors underpinning this transformative shift are twofold. Foremost among them is the robust economic growth and the continuous enhancement of household disposable income, which have drastically strengthened citizens' purchasing power. Furthermore, the nationwide implementation of high-quality development strategies and rural revitalizing initiatives has bridged regional disparities, enabling smart and eco-friendly appliances to penetrate broader consumer demographics. Consequently, durable goods have transitioned from luxury symbols into standard household necessities.

In conclusion, the surge in consumer appliance ownership bears vivid testimony to the monumental improvement in people's living standards. Looking ahead, as consumption upgrading accelerates, intelligent and green products will undoubtedly inject fresh vitality into our pursuit of high-quality life.

- structure: 首段精准概括耐用消费品拥有量十年上升趋势；第二段从居民可支配收入增长与乡村振兴/高质量发展双重视角深入归因；第三段总结提炼民生福祉飞跃并积极展望未来消费升级。

As is vividly and subtly portrayed in the cartoon, two mountaineers are resting on their journey up a rugged slope. One exhausted climber sits down on the ground, wiping sweat and lamenting that he cannot go any further. In sharp contrast, his companion stands firmly, taking a sip of water while holding out his hand to encourage his peer to keep pressing onward. The caption underneath explicitly reads: "Halfway Up the Mountain".

The metaphorical implication of this visual scene is both profound and inspiring: it is perseverance that constitutes the indispensable cornerstone of any remarkable accomplishment. In the voyage of life, when confronting daunting bottlenecks, people inevitably diverge in their attitudes. Those who surrender halfway invariably fall victim to momentary exhaustion, thereby losing the precious opportunity to witness the picturesque scenery at the summit. Conversely, individuals endowed with indomitable grit view temporary hardship not as a dead end, but as a stepping stone toward higher horizons. Historical records and personal triumphs abundantly prove that monumental breakthroughs stem from persistent endeavor rather than sheer luck.

From what has been discussed above, it is imperative for us, particularly contemporary college students, to foster psychological resilience in our academic and personal undertakings. Only by arming ourselves with unwavering determination can we conquer looming hurdles and eventually scale the pinnacle of life.

The cartoon above illustrates a thought-provoking scenario that is exceedingly prevalent in contemporary life. Four friends are gathered around a lavish dining table, surrounded by delicious dishes. However, instead of engaging in lively face-to-face conversation, each individual is burying their head in a glowing smartphone screen, entirely absorbed in cyberspace. The caption succinctly crystallizes the theme: "A Gathering in the Mobile Era".

The primary intention of the artist is not merely to satirize this bizarre scene, but to sound an alarm regarding the growing interpersonal alienation triggered by digital addiction. A multitude of underlying factors account for this dilemma. First and foremost, mobile applications and algorithm-driven content offer instant sensory gratification, subtly trapping users into compulsive screen consumption. Furthermore, the relentless pace of modern society often leaves young adults emotionally exhausted, prompting them to seek refuge in virtual relationships while neglecting genuine warmth in the physical world. Consequently, the very technology designed to bridge distances has ironically built an invisible wall between human hearts.

To reverse this worrisome trend, concerted endeavors must be mobilized. Individuals should cultivate digital moderation, consciously putting away mobile phones during family reunions and social gatherings. Only when we strike a balance between technology and humanity can we rebuild genuine intimacy.

范文正文：
Dear Professor Smith,

    I am writing on behalf of the English Association to cordially invite you to serve as a distinguished judge for our forthcoming annual Campus English Speech Contest.

    The contest, themed "Voices of the Youth and Global Dialogue", is scheduled to take place in the university grand auditorium from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM on November 15th. Twelve shortlisted candidates from diverse departments will deliver keynote speeches followed by impromptu question-and-answer sessions. Given your profound academic prestige and renowned expertise in public communication, your presence and insightful critiques would undoubtedly elevate the academic rigor of this event.

    We would be immensely honored if you could accept our invitation. Please confirm your availability at your earliest convenience.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

【英语一 范文参考：学业钻研与体育锻炼的平衡发展（书桌与跑鞋）】

范文正文：
The drawing presents a symbolic and harmonious scene: a young scholar sits upright at his study desk engrossed in textbooks, while a clean pair of running shoes is placed conspicuously on the floor beside him. This thoughtful combination illustrates the golden balance between intellectual endeavor and physical fitness.

The metaphorical message conveyed here is both clear and imperative: enduring academic excellence requires the firm underpinning of robust health. In contemporary society, fierce academic and career competition often misleads students into sacrificing physical wellness for marginal grade gains. However, prolonged sedentariness inevitably breeds mental exhaustion and chronic ailments. As the classical maxim perceptively proclaims, a sound mind resides in a sound body. Regular physical exercise not only revitalizes bodily vigor but also sharpens cognitive acuity, acting as an indispensable catalyst rather than a hindrance to academic distinction.

To conclude, intellectual cultivation and athletic training should be regarded as mutually reinforcing pillars of human growth. We university students ought to prioritize routine exercise, ensuring that our intellectual aspirations are sustained by robust physical stamina.

- structure: 第一段细致捕捉书桌与跑鞋的和谐并置并点明身心平衡主旨；第二段驳斥牺牲健康换学业的短视偏见，引用古训深入论证锻炼对心智活力的促进；第三段总结呼吁青年学子知行合一强化体魄。
- scoring_points: ['深刻扣紧体育与智育辩证统一的立意内核', '正反对比与名言引用有机融合', '词汇高阶精准（conspicuously, prolonged sedentariness, cognitive acuity）']

Dear Jack,

    I was thrilled to hear the wonderful news that you have been admitted to your dream postgraduate program abroad! Please accept my heartiest congratulations on this well-deserved milestone.

    Knowing how challenging it can be to adapt to an unfamiliar environment, I would like to offer a few practical suggestions. First and foremost, immersing yourself in daily conversational English before departure will significantly cushion the initial culture shock. Furthermore, cultivating basic culinary and financial self-reliance will prove indispensable in managing your independent daily routine. Lastly, maintaining an open mindset and actively participating in multicultural campus societies will help you forge lifelong international friendships.

    Wishing you a safe voyage and a tremendously rewarding academic journey overseas!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

chunks.content:
【英语一 范文参考：今日事今日毕与习惯性拖延的对照】
类型：大作文 - 图画作文（人生哲理与拒绝拖延） | 年份：2020 | 得分：19.0/20 (第一档 (高分示范)) | 词数：189

范文正文：
The cartoon presents a stark contrast between two students confronted with academic assignments. The one on the left rolls up his sleeves decisively, stating, "I will finish it right away and enjoy my leisure later." In sharp contrast, his counterpart reclines casually on the chair, murmuring, "There is still plenty of time, why hurry?"

The cartoonist vividly illustrates a common behavioral divergence in human life: decisive diligence versus chronic procrastination. Procrastination is often termed the thief of time; those who habitually postpone tasks into an uncertain future inevitably accumulate overwhelming anxiety, ultimately submitting hurried, subpar work. Conversely, individuals who practice immediate execution not only liberate themselves from cognitive burdens but also gain profound mastery over their schedules. As Edward Young perceptively remarked, procrastination steals our most irrecoverable asset—time.

From my perspective, overcoming the inertia of delay is vital for college students aiming for distinction. We should break formidable goals into manageable milestones and cultivate the habit of prompt action. Only by doing what should be done today can we greet tomorrow with composure and confidence.

- structure: 第一段用鲜明的动作与语言对照生动还原图画反差；第二段剖析拖延偷走时间与引发焦虑的危害，对比即刻行动带来的掌控感，巧妙化用名言；第三段针对大学生提出分解目标、即刻践行的行动建议。
- scoring_points: ['对比性极强，完全契合双人对比图画的考查重心', '成因分析深入到心理认知层面（cognitive burden, inertia of delay）', '结尾呼应题眼“今日事今日毕”']

chunks.content:
【英语一 范文参考：大学生选课反思：轻松混学分还是学真本领】
类型：大作文 - 图画作文（求真务实与选课反思） | 年份：2018 | 得分：18.5/20 (第一档 (高分示范)) | 词数：188

范文正文：
Unfolded in the elaborately painted cartoon is a revealing scene of college course selection. Two undergraduates sit before a computer monitor holding diametrically opposed attitudes. One student searches exclusively for courses characterized by lenient grading and minimal homework, while his companion thoughtfully prioritizes classes that impart cutting-edge knowledge and practical competence.

The drawing captures a pervasive dilemma on contemporary campuses: shortsighted pragmatism versus the genuine pursuit of knowledge. Enticed by the illusion of effortless high marks, a concerning number of students treat higher education as a mere diploma mill, avoiding intellectual challenges. However, superficial grades acquired without rigorous training resemble houses built on quicksand, leaving graduates vulnerable when entering the fiercely competitive job market. Genuine higher education is designed to stretch intellectual horizons and forge problem-solving faculties through rigorous academic discipline.

In light of the above discussion, undergraduates must fundamentally re-examine their educational values. We should discard opportunistic shortcuts and embrace demanding courses with enthusiasm, since real competence is forged only through strenuous intellectual labor.

阅卷点评：
- structure: 首段用完全倒装句起笔引出选课电脑屏幕前的态度对立；次段深入批判功利主义与“混文凭”短视心态，指出缺乏真才实学的成绩单如同流沙建房；末段呼吁树立正确学业观、敢于迎接智力挑战。
- scoring_points: ['立意高远，直击大学教育本质与功利主义危害', '隐喻生动（diploma mill, houses built on quicksand）', '批判性思维与说服力极强']
- highlights: ['holding diametrically opposed attitudes (持有截然相反的态度)', 'shortsighted pragmatism versus genuine pursuit of knowledge (短视功利主义与求知初心的博弈)', 'resemble houses built on quicksand (宛如建在流沙之上的房屋)', 'forged only through strenuous intellectual labor (唯有在艰辛的智力锤炼中方能铸就)']

Dear Fellow Students,

    In a bid to curb escalating white pollution and build a sustainable campus, we hereby launch this proposal to advocate green living across our university.

    To translate our environmental commitment into tangible actions, we earnestly encourage everyone to practice the following measures. In the first place, please substitute disposable plastic bags and cups with reusable cloth totes and refillable tumblers in daily dining. Furthermore, sorting dining hall refuse consciously and rejecting single-use cutlery during takeaway orders will remarkably lighten our campus waste disposal burden.

    Individual efforts may seem modest, but collective consistency can work miracles. Let us act today to safeguard our shared ecological sanctuary!

Yours sincerely,
The Students' Union

范文正文：
As is vividly portrayed in the drawing, an ironic contrast is drawn between two book owners. On the left side, a man sits surrounded by towering bookshelves, sighing helplessly that he possesses far too many volumes to ever finish. On the right side, however, another reader sits calmly by the window, totally immersed in completing a single masterpiece with deep appreciation.

The drawing conveys a thought-stimulating truth about knowledge acquisition: the quality of focused reading far outweighs the vanity of superficial hoarding. In our information-saturated era, people frequently equate possessing resources with possessing wisdom. Many succumb to the illusion of knowledge by buying mountains of books without ever turning a page. Nevertheless, skimming hundreds of titles fleetingly merely skims the surface, whereas digesting a single masterpiece thoroughly enriches one's intellect and nurtures critical thinking.

In my perspective, real learning demands relentless concentration and disciplined execution. Rather than being paralyzed by the abundance of unread volumes, we should begin with the book right before our eyes, reading it with depth and earnest reflection.

chunks.content:
【英语一 范文参考：榜样的力量与家庭教育：看电视催读书 vs 陪伴孩子共同学习】
类型：大作文 - 图画作文（家庭教育与言传身教） | 年份：2016 | 得分：19.0/20 (第一档 (高分示范)) | 词数：188

范文正文：
The cartoon presents a striking contrast between two parenting styles. In the left frame, a father relaxes comfortably on a sofa watching television, sternly commanding his son, "Go study hard!" In sharp contrast, the father in the right frame sits quietly by his child's side under a warm desk lamp, reading a book together as an inspiring example.

The illustrator astutely exposes a crucial truth in family upbringing: leading by example is incomparably superior to empty preaching. Children are keen observers who naturally imitate parental behavior rather than obey abstract orders. When parents indulge in passive amusement while imposing severe academic demands on their offspring, hypocrisy inevitably breeds resentment and resistance. Conversely, when parents embody self-discipline and intellectual curiosity in daily life, they subtly nurture a lifelong passion for learning in their children's hearts. As Albert Schweitzer famously noted, example is not merely the best way to influence others; it is the only way.

To foster healthy next generations, parents should step down from authoritarian pedestals and become co-learners with their children. Only through genuine companionship can education bear sweet fruit.

阅卷点评：
- structure: 第一段以左右两幅画面直观描摹训斥与伴读的鲜明对比；第二段深入教育心理学机制，批判双标说教的虚伪，论证潜移默化言传身教的威力，引用史怀哲名言；第三段倡导家长走下威权神坛、与孩子共同成长。

chunks.content:
【英语一 范文参考：相携三十年：母亲牵幼子与成年子女搀扶衰老母亲】
类型：大作文 - 图画作文（孝道美德与相携反哺） | 年份：2014 | 得分：19.0/20 (第一档 (高分示范)) | 词数：189

范文正文：
The touching drawing spans across three decades to present two intertwined moments. In the first scene, a young mother gently holds her toddler's tiny hand, guiding his fledgling steps with endless patience. In the second scene thirty years later, the roles are reversed: the grown child tenderly supports his stooped, white-haired mother, walking hand in hand down the avenue of life.

The heartwarming picture pays a sublime tribute to filial piety, a cherished cornerstone of traditional Chinese virtues. Filial devotion is fundamentally a reciprocal obligation born out of gratitude. Parents dedicate their prime years and boundless love to nurturing their offspring into maturity. When relentless time bends their posture and dims their eyesight, it is the sacred moral duty of adult children to provide reciprocal comfort and companionship. Sadly, in contemporary society, some individuals neglect their aging parents under the pretext of hectic careers, forgetting that emotional presence outweighs material allowances.

In conclusion, caring for the elderly reflects the moral conscience of a civilized society. We should cherish our parents while time permits, repaying their unconditional love with attentive companionship and heartfelt warmth.

- structure: 第一段以时光流转为主线，优美刻画牵手三十年角色反转的温情细节；第二段将孝道定位为反哺深情与道德契约，批评以工作繁忙为借口忽视父母陪伴的不良现象；第三段由个人美德上升到社会良知的高度发起倡议。

As is vividly portrayed in the cartoon, a perplexed college graduate stands before an intersection, staring intently at four signposts pointing in divergent directions: employment, postgraduate entrance examinations, studying abroad, and civil service. With a backpack on his shoulder, his hesitant expression reveals the profound uncertainty of his dilemma.

The picture mirrors a common crossroads that almost every university graduate must confront. As higher education expands rapidly, graduating youth are blessed with diversified opportunities yet burdened with severe decision anxiety. Some blindly follow peer trends without self-evaluation, often abandoning their initial choices later in regret. However, there is no universally supreme path in life; the optimum choice is the one that aligns harmoniously with one's genuine passion, academic aptitudes, and realistic conditions.

From my perspective, graduates should refrain from being paralyzed by hesitation. What is truly essential is conducting an honest self-assessment and maintaining steadfast determination once a path is chosen. After all, success is determined not by which road we select, but by the relentless effort we invest upon it.

范文正文：
As is vividly illustrated in the drawing, a bottle of milk accidentally falls to the ground, spilling half of its liquid. Confronted with the exact same occurrence, two individuals display diametrically conflicting psychological responses. The person on the left covers his face in sheer despair, mourning that "everything is ruined," whereas his companion calmly stoops down, cheerfully remarking that "fortunately there is still some left."

The cartoon conveys an invaluable philosophical lesson regarding life mindset: our reality is molded not by external mishaps, but by the cognitive perspective through which we interpret them. In our lifetime journey, unforeseen misfortunes and setbacks are virtually inevitable. While a defeatist pessimist paralyzes himself in unproductive grief over spilled milk, an unshakable optimist actively directs his attention toward salvaging remaining resources and uncovering hidden opportunities. As the proverbial saying goes, life is ten percent what happens to you and ninety percent how you react to it.

In conclusion, cultivating an optimistic disposition is vital for anyone striving to surmount challenges. Whenever setbacks strike, we must refrain from sterile laments, maintain a hopeful heart, and forge ahead with fortitude.

Dishearteningly, instead of admiring the natural scenery quietly, they casually discard bottles and plastic wraps into the pristine water, leaving an unsightly trail of floating rubbish behind their boat.

The picture illustrates a distressing conflict between booming tourism and lagging public morality. With living standards rising rapidly, travel has become a popular leisure pursuit. However, uncivilized behaviors like littering not only desecrate picturesque landscapes but also pose grave threats to vulnerable aquatic ecosystems. Such misconduct exposes a glaring deficit in civic decorum and environmental responsibility among certain travelers who prioritize personal convenience at the expense of public well-being.

In my perspective, safeguarding our natural ecology demands collaborative societal endeavors. On one hand, tourism authorities should implement stricter supervision and penalize littering rigorously. On the other hand, public education must be amplified to nurture genuine ecological consciousness. Only when every tourist practices self-restraint can our waters remain lucid and our mountains verdant.

范文正文：
As is clearly illustrated in the bar chart, the proportion of college students engaging in part-time jobs increases progressively from freshmen to seniors. Specifically, only about 10% of freshmen take part-time jobs, while the percentage rises to approximately 30% for sophomores. The figure continues to climb to around 50% for juniors, and ultimately peaks at 65% for seniors.

Several factors may account for this upward trend. First and foremost, as students advance in their academic careers, they develop a stronger desire for financial independence and practical experience. Senior students, in particular, feel the pressure of the approaching job market and seek to enhance their competitiveness through work experience. Furthermore, higher-grade students generally have lighter course loads and more flexible schedules, which enables them to balance study and work more effectively. Additionally, the influence of career-oriented education and peer examples also motivates students to seek part-time employment opportunities.

In conclusion, the increasing participation in part-time jobs among college students reflects a positive trend of career awareness and self-reliance. However, it is essential that students strike a proper balance between work and academic responsibilities to ensure their overall development.

The pie chart above shows the factors that consumers consider when choosing a restaurant. As can be seen, taste takes up the largest share at 36.3%, followed by service quality at 26.8%. Price and environment account for 20.5% and 12.6% respectively. Other factors make up 3.8%.

There are several reasons behind this phenomenon. First, food quality is the most basic requirement for any restaurant. Consumers naturally prioritize taste because it directly determines their dining satisfaction. Second, with the improvement of living standards, people are paying more attention to service quality. Good service can greatly enhance the dining experience. Third, although price is still a concern, it is no longer the top priority for most consumers, which shows that people's consumption concepts have changed.

In conclusion, the chart tells us that consumers' dining choices are influenced by multiple factors, with taste and service being the most important. Restaurant owners should focus on improving food quality and service to attract more customers.

范文正文：
The line graph shows the number of people who visited museums from 2013 to 2017. We can see that the number increased year by year.

In 2013, about 6 million people visited museums. Then the number grew slowly. In 2015, it reached about 7.5 million. After that, the number continued to increase and in 2017, it reached about 9 million. So we can see the number almost doubled in five years.

I think there are some reasons for this trend. First, people's life is getting better, so they have more time and money to visit museums. Second, the government built more museums and made them free to visit. Third, people care more about culture and history now.

In conclusion, more and more people visit museums. I think this is a good thing for our society. The government should continue to support museums.

chunks.title: 【英语二】范文参考[大作文-表格] 2014年 中国城镇和乡村人口变化情况 13分 (第一档)

类型：大作文 - 表格 | 年份：2014 | 得分：13 (第一档) | 词数：178

范文正文：
The table above presents the changes in China's urban and rural populations from 1990 to 2010. According to the data, the urban population experienced a remarkable increase, rising from 300 million in 1990 to 670 million in 2010. In stark contrast, the rural population witnessed a notable decline, dropping from 840 million to 680 million over the same period. Significantly, the year 2010 marked a historical turning point when the urban population nearly equaled the rural population.

This dramatic shift can be attributed to several factors. Primarily, China's rapid industrialization and economic reforms have created abundant job opportunities in cities, attracting a massive influx of rural migrants. Moreover, the urban areas offer superior educational resources, healthcare facilities, and public services, which serve as powerful magnets for rural residents. Additionally, government policies promoting urbanization have accelerated this population redistribution.

In summary, the data clearly reflects China's ongoing urbanization process. As this trend is likely to continue, policymakers should focus on ensuring sustainable urban development while also revitalizing rural communities to achieve balanced regional growth.

- content: 数据描述准确详细，分析深入有力，总结具有前瞻性
- organization: 结构严谨，段落分配合理，衔接自然

chunks.title: 【英语二】范文参考[大作文-柱状图] 2024年 大学生毕业去向规划与动机（考研、就业、出国、创业）调查 15分 (第一档（满分标杆）)
chunks.content:
【英语二 范文参考：大学生毕业去向规划与动机（考研、就业、出国、创业）调查】
类型：大作文 - 柱状图 | 年份：2024 | 得分：15 (第一档（满分标杆）) | 词数：188

范文正文：
The column chart delineates a clear picture of college graduates' post-graduation choices in a Chinese university. As is revealed by the statistics, preparing for postgraduate entrance examinations constitutes the largest proportion, occupying a staggering 48.5%. Seeking immediate employment follows as the second most favored option at 32.2%, whereas pursuing overseas studies and launching startups account for a relatively modest 12.1% and 7.2% respectively.

Several intertwined factors prominently contribute to this phenomenon. To begin with, under the mounting pressure of today's competitive job market, an advanced academic degree is widely perceived as an indispensable stepping stone to securing high-paying positions and career advancement. Furthermore, higher education institutes have continually expanded postgraduate enrollment, which further fuels students' aspiration for deeper academic exploration. In addition, economic uncertainties and shifting entrepreneurial climates have prompted graduates to adopt a more conservative attitude, prioritizing skill enhancement over immediate entrepreneurial ventures.

From my perspective, this trend reflects young individuals' prudent pursuit of long-term personal competitiveness. Nevertheless, university authorities and policymakers ought to provide tailored career guidance, encouraging students to align their postgraduate aspirations with genuine professional interests rather than blindly following the herd.

- content: 数据提炼极度精炼且抓住了主次（48.5%为极值重点分析，32.2%次之，其余合并简述），原因分析从就业市场压力、高校扩招政策、宏观经济心理三个宏观与微观维度深入剖析，结尾点评极具辩证深度

- language: 学术化词汇极其丰富（delineates, constitutes, staggering, intertwined, indispensable stepping stone, blindly following the herd），句式极富节奏韵律，包含从句、分词短语及并列对比结构，全篇无任何语法与语用瑕疵
- chart_description: 数据分类汇总精准，避开了机械流水账报数据的弊病

delineates a clear picture of（高级图表引入词）, occupying a staggering 48.5%（精准修饰语）, intertwined factors prominently contribute to, an indispensable stepping stone to, fuels students' aspiration for, prudent pursuit of long-term personal competitiveness, rather than blindly following the herd（熟语地道运用）

范文正文：
The line graph demonstrates the dynamic changes in daily reading time spent on digital devices versus traditional paper books among urban residents from 2015 to 2019. It is manifest that mobile reading time underwent an explosive growth, soaring from 25 minutes per day in 2015 to nearly 70 minutes in 2019. In sharp contrast, time devoted to reading printed books followed a steady downward trajectory, declining moderately from 45 minutes to 30 minutes over the five-year span.

Such a noticeable contrast can be principally ascribed to technological advancement and changing lifestyle rhythms. In this fast-paced information era, portable smartphones and electronic reading applications allow citizens to utilize fragmented time efficiently during daily commutes. Moreover, digital reading platforms provide instantaneous access to an enormous diversity of publications at minimal financial expense, which substantially eclipses the physical limitations of conventional print media.

To summarize, the predominance of digital reading has undoubtedly become an irreversible historical trend. Nonetheless, given that in-depth reading remains vital for critical thinking, we should cultivate balanced reading habits rather than succumbing completely to fragmented information.

As the chart depicts, maintaining a balanced diet holds the largest share at 42.0%, followed by taking regular exercise, which accounts for 31.5%. Meanwhile, ensuring sufficient sleep and seeking mental relaxation represent 16.5% and 10.0% respectively.

This pattern reflects the prevailing health awareness among modern citizens. On one hand, people are increasingly conscious of nutritional science, realizing that a wholesome diet forms the foundation of immune defense against chronic illnesses. On the other hand, the popularization of fitness facilities encourages people to integrate regular physical exercise into their weekly routines. However, the relatively lower percentages of sleep and mental wellbeing suggest that workplace stress still impedes holistic health.

In brief, the survey reveals that healthy eating and exercise are widely embraced. Moving forward, individuals should pay equal attention to psychological wellness and rest to attain a truly healthy lifestyle.

chunks.content:

范文正文：
Dear Tom,

    I am delighted to hear that you are interested in Chinese traditional festivals. I would like to recommend the Spring Festival, which is the most important celebration in China.

    The Spring Festival, also known as Chinese New Year, usually falls in January or February. During this festival, families reunite for a grand dinner on New Year's Eve, enjoying traditional dishes such as dumplings and spring rolls. People also set off fireworks, hang red lanterns, and exchange red envelopes as symbols of good luck. Additionally, various folk activities, including dragon dances and temple fairs, make the festival even more vibrant.

    I believe experiencing the Spring Festival would give you a profound understanding of Chinese culture. I look forward to your visit.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

chunks.title: 【英语二】范文参考[小作文-邀请信] 2023年 邀请外国朋友参加学校举办的中国文化节活动 9分 (第一档)
chunks.content:
【英语二 范文参考：邀请外国朋友参加学校举办的中国文化节活动】
类型：小作文 - 邀请信 | 年份：2023 | 得分：9 (第一档) | 词数：118

范文正文：
Dear Jack,

    I am writing to invite you to attend the Chinese Culture Festival, which will be held in our university next Saturday.

    The festival is designed to showcase the richness and diversity of Chinese culture. A wide range of activities will be available, including calligraphy workshops, traditional music performances, and a tea ceremony demonstration. Furthermore, you will have the opportunity to taste authentic Chinese cuisine from different regions. The event will run from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. at the Student Activity Center.

    I believe this would be an excellent opportunity for you to deepen your understanding of Chinese culture. I sincerely hope you can join us.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

阅卷点评：
- content: 完整覆盖邀请目的、活动详情、期待参加三个要点，内容丰富
- organization: 结构清晰，衔接词使用恰当（furthermore, including），逻辑流畅
- language: 词汇丰富（showcase, diversity, authentic, demonstrate），句式多样（定语从句、被动语态、分词短语），准确无误
- format: 格式规范

亮点表达：
showcase the richness and diversity, A wide range of activities, authentic Chinese cuisine, deepen your understanding

错误分析与修改：
无明显语言错误

chunks.title: 【英语二】范文参考[小作文-通知] 2022年 介绍校园美食节并邀请国际学生参加 8分 (第二档)
chunks.content:
【英语二 范文参考：介绍校园美食节并邀请国际学生参加】
类型：小作文 - 通知 | 年份：2022 | 得分：8 (第二档) | 词数：110

范文正文：
NOTICE

To enrich the campus life of international students, the Student Union is going to organize a Campus Food Festival. The details are as follows.

The food festival will be held at the Student Cafeteria from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on December 15th. During the festival, students from various countries are invited to prepare and share their traditional dishes. There will also be a cooking competition, and prizes will be awarded to the top three contestants.

All international students are welcome to participate. Please sign up at the Student Union office by December 10th.

The Student Union
November 30, 2022

阅卷点评：
- content: 涵盖了活动目的、时间地点、活动内容、参与方式等所有要点
- organization: 通知结构完整，信息层次分明
- language: 语言准确得体，使用了被动语态（will be held, are invited, will be awarded），表达规范

enrich the campus life, prizes will be awarded to, All international students are welcome to participate

chunks.title: 【英语二】范文参考[小作文-道歉信] 2018年 因故取消旅行计划，向史密斯教授致歉并建议后续见面 6分 (第三档)
chunks.content:
【英语二 范文参考：因故取消旅行计划，向史密斯教授致歉并建议后续见面】
类型：小作文 - 道歉信 | 年份：2018 | 得分：6 (第三档) | 词数：102

范文正文：
Dear Professor Smith,

    I am sorry to tell you that I can not go to travel with you next week. I feel very sorry about this.

    The reason is that my mother is sick and I need go home to take care of her. So I have to cancel our plan. I hope you can understand me.

    I think we can go to travel together in next month. I will contact you later. Sorry again.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

阅卷点评：
- content: 覆盖了道歉、原因、补救方案三个要点，但展开不够充分
- organization: 三段结构存在，但语言组织较为松散
- language: 有多处语法错误，词汇较为基础，句式单一
- format: 格式正确

亮点表达：
无

错误分析与修改：
- can not → cannot（拼写）
- go to travel → go on the trip / take the trip
- I need go → I need to go
- go to travel together in next month → go on a trip together next month（去掉in）
- Sorry again → Once again, I sincerely apologize（更正式）
- feel very sorry → feel terribly sorry / deeply regret

chunks.title: 【英语二】范文参考[小作文-投诉信] 2012真题模拟年 在某电子商城购买了一台电子词典，收到后发现存在质量问题，写信投诉并要求退换及赔偿 9.5分 (第一档)
chunks.content:
【英语二 范文参考：在某电子商城购买了一台电子词典，收到后发现存在质量问题，写信投诉并要求退换及赔偿】
类型：小作文 - 投诉信 | 年份：2012真题模拟 | 得分：9.5 (第一档) | 词数：128

范文正文：
Dear Customer Service Manager,

    I am writing to express my profound dissatisfaction with an electronic dictionary (Order No. ED-98231) that I purchased from your online store on October 3rd.

    To my extreme disappointment, upon unboxing the device, I discovered that the touchscreen was noticeably unresponsive. Furthermore, the battery drains completely within less than two hours of regular usage, which contradicts the ten-hour battery life advertised on your website. Considering that I rely on this tool extensively for my upcoming postgraduate examination preparation, this defective product has caused immense inconvenience.

    Under these circumstances, I strongly request either a prompt replacement with a fully functional unit or a complete refund, including the shipping fee. Your swift attention to this matter would be greatly appreciated.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

阅卷点评：
- content: 投诉事由明确、问题描述具体、诉求合理明确，全面涵盖题目要求
- organization: 层次极为分明：表明不满与订单信息→详述两个产品缺陷及影响→提出明确解决方案与期待回复
- language: 语言严谨地道、语气不卑不亢、选词高级（profound dissatisfaction, unresponsive, drains, defective, immense inconvenience）
- format: 完全符合商务/客诉书信格式规范

亮点表达：
express my profound dissatisfaction with, To my extreme disappointment, upon unboxing..., contradicts the ten-hour battery life advertised, caused immense inconvenience, a prompt replacement with a fully functional unit

chunks.title: 【英语二】范文参考[小作文-感谢信] 2010真题变式年 写信感谢房东格林先生在访学期间给予的热情照料与帮助 8.5分 (第二档)
chunks.content:

Dear Mr. Green,

    I am writing this letter to extend my heartfelt gratitude to you for your kind hospitality and generous assistance during my study in your country.

    I truly appreciate everything you have done for me over the past six months. Not only did you provide me with a cozy and comfortable living environment, but you also guided me through local customs and helped me adapt to university life smoothly. Your patience and warmth made me feel right at home, even though I was thousands of miles away from my family.

    Please convey my warmest regards to Mrs. Green. I sincerely hope to welcome you to visit China in the near future.

Yours sincerely,

- format: 传统私人感谢信格式准确规范

chunks.title: 【英语二】范文参考[小作文-推荐信] 2021真题模拟年 向即将前往中国留学的外国朋友推荐一座具有代表性的中国城市及理由 9.0分 (第一档)
chunks.content:
【英语二 范文参考：向即将前往中国留学的外国朋友推荐一座具有代表性的中国城市及理由】
类型：小作文 - 推荐信 | 年份：2021真题模拟 | 得分：9.0 (第一档) | 词数：122

范文正文：
Dear David,

    Learning that you are planning to pursue your postgraduate studies in China, I am more than enthusiastic to recommend Xi'an as your destination.

    Xi'an is widely celebrated as an ancient capital with a magnificent cultural heritage spanning thousands of years. Living there, you will be surrounded by world-renowned historical wonders such as the Terracotta Warriors and the Ancient City Wall. Meanwhile, Xi'an is also an energetic educational hub with prestigious universities and cutting-edge research institutes, where you can acquire exceptional academic training. Additionally, the vibrant local food scene will surely enrich your everyday life.

    I am confident that your stay in Xi'an will be both fruitful and unforgettable. Wish you every success!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

阅卷点评：
- content: 推荐理由从历史文化底蕴、教育学术资源、生活宜居三方面展开，极具说服力
- organization: 开头点题并表明热情态度，主体按逻辑多维度推进，结尾送上诚挚祝愿
- language: 词汇精炼丰富（magnificent cultural heritage, prestigious universities, vibrant, fruitful），从句运用自如
- format: 称呼、首段背景、主体论证、结尾致意、落款一应俱全

亮点表达：
Learning that you are planning to...（分词短语作状语开头）, widely celebrated as an ancient capital with..., prestigious universities and cutting-edge research, both fruitful and unforgettable

无明显语言错误

chunks.title: 【英语二】范文参考[小作文-询问信] 2019真题变式年 向主办方写信询问国际青年夏令营的报名条件、住宿安排及费用明细 5.5分 (第三档)
chunks.content:
【英语二 范文参考：向主办方写信询问国际青年夏令营的报名条件、住宿安排及费用明细】
类型：小作文 - 询问信 | 年份：2019真题变式 | 得分：5.5 (第三档) | 词数：96

范文正文：
Dear Sir or Madam,

    I am writing to ask some informations about the International Youth Summer Camp held in this summer.

    First, I want to know who can join this camp and if there has any English test requirement. Second, could you please tell me about the living place? Do students live in school hotel or outside? Finally, what is the cost of the camp? Does the price include food and books?

    I will be very happy if you can answer my questions soon. Thank you very much.

Yours faithfully,
Li Ming

阅卷点评：
- content: 基本问清了三个要点（条件、住宿、费用），但句式和展开非常生硬浅显
- organization: 机械使用了 First, Second, Finally 连词，句子之间缺少自然衔接
- language: 基础语法错误较多（informations 不可数误用、there has 句型混淆、living place 表达不地道），词汇简单单调
- format: 称呼使用 Dear Sir or Madam，落款使用 Yours faithfully，格式对应正确

亮点表达：
无

错误分析与修改：
- some informations → some information（不可数名词）
- held in this summer → to be held this summer（时间状语与非谓语错误）
- if there has any English test requirement → if there is any English proficiency requirement（there be句型误用has）
- living place → accommodation arrangements（用词过于口语化）
- school hotel → campus dormitories / university residence
- I will be very happy if → I would appreciate it if you could clarify these details

chunks.title: 【英语二】范文参考[小作文-倡议书/告示] 2020真题模拟年 以学生会名义写一份倡议书，呼吁全校师生开展“光盘行动”，杜绝食堂餐饮浪费 7.5分 (第二档)
chunks.content:
【英语二 范文参考：以学生会名义写一份倡议书，呼吁全校师生开展“光盘行动”，杜绝食堂餐饮浪费】
类型：小作文 - 倡议书/告示 | 年份：2020真题模拟 | 得分：7.5 (第二档) | 词数：115

范文正文：
A Proposal on Cherishing Food

Dear Teachers and Students,

    Recently, the problem of food waste in our campus canteens has attracted wide concern. In order to promote a sustainable lifestyle, we are launching the "Clean Plate Campaign" and appeal to everyone to take action.

    To achieve this goal, we suggest taking the following measures. First, please order food reasonably according to your appetite instead of ordering excessively. Second, cultivate the habit of finishing all the food on your plate. Third, if there is leftover food, take it away rather than throwing it into trash bins.

    Every grain of rice comes from hard work. Let us start today and say no to food waste!

Postgraduate Student Union
October 7, 2026

阅卷点评：
- content: 呼吁主题突出，提出了具体可行的三点倡议，结尾有号召力
- organization: 标题、倡议背景、三点具体措施、结尾呼吁，结构完整合理
- language: 语言流畅，使用了 sustainable lifestyle, Clean Plate Campaign, cultivate the habit 等较好短语，衔接词略显传统
- format: 倡议书公开信格式标准，标题居中，有受众称呼，署名与日期准确

亮点表达：
attracted wide concern, promote a sustainable lifestyle, Every grain of rice comes from hard work（熟语英译恰当）

错误分析与修改：
- First, Second, Third 可以换成更自然的衔接方式，如 To begin with, Furthermore, Lastly
- trash bins 可以更学术化地替换为 garbage bins 或 waste containers

chunks.title: 【英语二】范文参考[小作文-建议信（低分对比样本）] 2024真题对照年 外国友人想了解中国传统节日，写信推荐一个节日并说明理由（低分典型卷） 3.0分 (第四档)
chunks.content:
【英语二 范文参考：外国友人想了解中国传统节日，写信推荐一个节日并说明理由（低分典型卷）】
类型：小作文 - 建议信（低分对比样本） | 年份：2024真题对照 | 得分：3.0 (第四档) | 词数：68

范文正文：
Dear friend
    China have many festival. I recommend you the Mid-Autumn Day. It is very good. In that day, China people eat moon cake and see moon with family. Because moon is round, so mean family together. You will very happy if you come. Welcome to China.
Li Ming

阅卷点评：
- content: 内容极其单薄，虽然提及中秋节，但展开不足2句话，没有充实细节
- organization: 未进行规范分段，缺乏句子连接词，逻辑跳跃碎裂
- language: 错误极多（主谓不一致、形容词作谓语缺少be动词、because/so连用、单复数缺失），词汇极其匮乏
- format: 格式不合格：称呼后漏掉逗号，落款未空行换行顶格，无致意语（Yours sincerely）

亮点表达：
无

错误分析与修改：
- Dear friend → Dear Friend,（大写与逗号遗漏）
- China have → China has（主谓不一致）
- many festival → many festivals（名词单复数）
- China people → Chinese people
- see moon → admire the full moon / watch the moon
- Because ... so ... 连用（典型中式语法病句）
- mean family together → it symbolizes family reunion
- You will very happy → You will be very happy（缺谓语动词）
- 字数严重不足（仅68词，远低于100词要求）
- 无礼貌结束敬语（Yours sincerely缺失）

chunks.title: 【英语一】图画大作文高分段落句型：第一段：图画精准描摹与细节勾勒 (Picture Description)
chunks.content:
【英语一 图画作文段落句型 - 第一段：图画精准描摹与细节勾勒 (Picture Description)】
大纲建议篇幅：30-45 词，3-4 句话（忌过长，重点服务于第二段立意）
推荐高分句型列表：
- 句型：单图生动引入 (Single-Picture Opening)
  模板：As is vividly and subtly depicted in the drawing above, [主体] is [动作], with [细节伴随/神态].
  范例：As is vividly and subtly depicted in the drawing above, an exhausted young man is resting halfway up a steep hill, murmuring that he cannot climb any further.
  亮点分析：vividly and subtly (生动而微妙地); halfway up a steep hill (地点生动具体)
- 句型：倒装句震撼引题 (Inverted Opening for Visual Impact)
  模板：Unfolded in the elaborately painted cartoon is an eye-catching and thought-provoking scene: [描述画面核心内容].
  范例：Unfolded in the elaborately painted cartoon is an eye-catching and thought-provoking scene: four youngsters are seated around a dinner table, yet each is thoroughly engrossed in his own smartphone.
  亮点分析：Unfolded in... is... 完全倒装，句式高级且极具学术阅卷辨识度
- 句型：双图鲜明对比 (Two-Picture Contrast Opening)
  模板：The cartoon presents a stark contrast between two distinct scenarios: while [场景一内容], [场景二内容].
  范例：The cartoon presents a stark contrast between two distinct scenarios: while one student lies lazily on the couch watching television, the other studies diligently alongside his supportive father.
  亮点分析：presents a stark contrast between... (呈现鲜明对比)
- 句型：文字标语巧妙植入 (Incorporating Captions & Dialogues)
  模板：What commands our immediate attention is the conspicuous caption [inscribed beneath / floating above], which reads: "[文字内容]".
  范例：What commands our immediate attention is the conspicuous caption inscribed beneath the illustration, which reads: "Finish it today, or put it off until tomorrow?"
  亮点分析：commands our immediate attention (吸引我们的注意); conspicuous caption (醒目的图题)
- 句型：神态动作微观特写 (Micro-detail & Facial Expression)
  模板：With [神态/表情，如: a serene smile playing on his lips / brows furrowed in intense despair], [主体] demonstrates [某种心理状态].
  范例：With brows furrowed in visible hesitation, the graduate stands transfixed at the crossroads, pondering his future career trajectory.
  亮点分析：brows furrowed in visible hesitation (眉头紧锁犹豫不决，生动刻画心理状态)

chunks.title: 【英语一】图画大作文高分段落句型：第二段：寓意纵深阐释与因果论证 (Significance & In-depth Analysis)
chunks.content:
【英语一 图画作文段落句型 - 第二段：寓意纵深阐释与因果论证 (Significance & In-depth Analysis)】
大纲建议篇幅：90-120 词，5-7 句话（全文核心得分点，占分权重最高）
推荐高分句型列表：
- 句型：象征隐喻开门见山 (Unveiling Symbolic Meaning)
  模板：The primary intention of the painter is far from rendering a casual caricature; instead, it metaphorically illuminates the profound truth that [核心主旨/品质/社会现象].
  范例：The primary intention of the painter is far from rendering a casual caricature; instead, it metaphorically illuminates the profound truth that perseverance is the indispensable cornerstone of any monumental achievement.
  亮点分析：far from rendering... instead, it metaphorically illuminates... 双重否定转折提升思辨力度
- 句型：社会成因递进剖析 (Multidimensional Causation Chain)
  模板：A multitude of interconnected factors can account for this prevailing phenomenon. Foremost among them is [原因一]. Furthermore, [原因二]. Last but not least, [原因三].
  范例：A multitude of interconnected factors can account for this prevailing phenomenon. Foremost among them is the intense social pressure that compels individuals to seek immediate sensory gratification. Furthermore, the relentless influx of digital notifications has drastically fragmented people's attention spans.
  亮点分析：multitude of interconnected factors (多元互联因素); Foremost among them is... (倒装强调首因)
- 句型：正反严密对比论证 (Antithetical Argumentation)
  模板：Those who embrace [积极品质] are bound to [获得成就]; on the contrary, those who succumb to [消极恶习] will inevitably [遭受恶果].
  范例：Those who embrace proactive execution are bound to unlock endless possibilities and self-fulfillment; on the contrary, those who succumb to habitual procrastination will inevitably drown in endless remorse and missed opportunities.
  亮点分析：Those who embrace... are bound to... on the contrary, those who succumb to... 对仗工整，逻辑说服力极强
- 句型：哲理名言升华点题 (Proverbial Anchor)
  模板：As the timeless adage eloquently puts it, "[名言内容]", which underscores the enduring value of [主题核心].
  范例：As the timeless adage eloquently puts it, "Constant dripping hollows out the stone, not by force, but through persistence", which underscores the enduring value of tenacity in navigating life's turbulent journey.
  亮点分析：eloquently puts it (精辟指出); underscores the enduring value of... (彰显了……的长青价值)
- 句型：危害影响纵深透视 (Analyzing Negative Repercussions)
  模板：Should this detrimental tendency be allowed to persist unchecked, it would not merely [个人危害], but also [社会危害].
  范例：Should this detrimental tendency be allowed to persist unchecked, it would not merely paralyze individual ambitions, but also undermine the moral vitality of society as a whole.
  亮点分析：Should this... be allowed to... (虚拟语气倒装，展示高级句式储备)

chunks.title: 【英语一】图画大作文高分段落句型：第三段：建设性对策与展望升华 (Constructive Measures & Outlook)
chunks.content:
【英语一 图画作文段落句型 - 第三段：建设性对策与展望升华 (Constructive Measures & Outlook)】
大纲建议篇幅：40-55 词，3-4 句话（标本兼治，首尾呼应）
推荐高分句型列表：
- 句型：段落过渡承上启下 (Transition to Solutions)
  模板：In view of the compelling arguments expounded above, it is imperative for [主语，如: us / the entire society] to orchestrate concerted efforts to [采取行动].
  范例：In view of the compelling arguments expounded above, it is imperative for the entire society to orchestrate concerted efforts to nurture genuine cultural confidence among the youth.
  亮点分析：orchestrate concerted efforts (通力协作/协同发力)
- 句型：个人自律觉醒层面 (Individual Awakening & Habit Cultivation)
  模板：On the personal front, we college students ought to cultivate a steadfast consciousness of [主题词], translating noble aspirations into everyday self-discipline.
  范例：On the personal front, we college students ought to cultivate a steadfast consciousness of time management, translating noble aspirations into everyday self-discipline.
  亮点分析：translate noble aspirations into everyday self-discipline (将崇高志向转化为日常自律)
- 句型：社会/政策协同支撑层面 (Institutional & Social Guidance)
  模板：Simultaneously, relevant authorities, schools and media should shoulder their due responsibilities to create a favorable cultural atmosphere through sound guidance and effective oversight.
  范例：Simultaneously, educational institutions and parents should shoulder their due responsibilities to lead by positive example, fostering an encouraging environment for mutual growth.
  亮点分析：shoulder their due responsibilities (勇担应尽之责); favorable cultural atmosphere (良好文化氛围)
- 句型：倒装句终极展望升华 (Inverted Concluding Climax)
  模板：Only when [条件一] and [条件二] are combined in earnest can we [实现美好愿景].
  范例：Only when personal fortitude and social guidance are seamlessly united can we surmount any obstacle and steer our nation toward an auspicious future.
  亮点分析：Only when... can we... 倒装句收尾，气势磅礴，第一档范文标配

chunks.title: 【英语一】应用文小作文高分句型与模板：告示与通知 (Notice / Announcement)
chunks.content:
【英语一 应用文句式规范 - 告示与通知 (Notice / Announcement)】
格式与考查特征：标题 NOTICE 居中；正文首段发布事由；次段交代时间、地点、资格、流程；尾段注明咨询途径；署名单位在右下方，绝不写 Dear 也不写 Li Ming 个人名义（通常署名 The Students' Union 或 Postgraduates' Association）
经典开篇句：
  * Notice is hereby given that [活动名称] is scheduled to be held from [时间] to [时间] at [地点].
  * We are immensely pleased to announce that a grand [活动名称] will be launched by [主办单位] next month.
  * In an effort to [活动目的，如: enrich campus cultural life], an exciting [活动名称] is about to take place.
正文要点展开句：
  * All postgraduate and undergraduate students who possess a fervent passion for [领域] are warmly encouraged to sign up.
  * The selection process comprises two consecutive rounds: a preliminary written screening and an oral demonstration.
  * Detailed submission guidelines, including paper formats and performance criteria, are accessible on our official university portal.
结语与期盼句：
  * Anyone interested in participating is requested to submit their application to [邮箱/地点] prior to [截止日期].
  * Should you have any inquiries or require further information, please feel free to reach out to us at [联系方式].
  * Come and join us to showcase your distinctive talent and win lucrative rewards!

chunks.title: 【英语一】应用文小作文高分句型与模板：备忘录 (Memorandum / Memo)
chunks.content:
【英语一 应用文句式规范 - 备忘录 (Memorandum / Memo)】
格式与考查特征：顶格四项抬头：TO (收件人), FROM (发件人), DATE (日期), SUBJECT (事由)；正文开门见山陈述现状问题；条目化列出改进举措；末尾规定反馈期限
经典开篇句：
  * This memorandum serves to summarize our recent evaluation regarding [问题/现状] and propose urgent action plans.
  * The purpose of this memo is to address several operational inefficiencies identified during the preliminary stage of [项目名称].
正文要点展开句：
  * In accordance with our latest assessment, the following corrective measures are to be implemented immediately:
  * First and foremost, a weekly milestone review will be instituted to ensure transparent communication across departments.
  * Furthermore, all documentation must be standardized and archived in the shared digital repository by Friday afternoon.
结语与期盼句：
  * Your strict compliance with the aforementioned procedures will be greatly appreciated.
  * Please review the attached schedule and communicate any operational concerns to my office by 5:00 PM tomorrow.

chunks.title: 【英语一】应用文小作文高分句型与模板：倡议书与公开信 (Proposal / Open Letter)
chunks.content:
【英语一 应用文句式规范 - 倡议书与公开信 (Proposal / Open Letter)】
格式与考查特征：面向全体师生或公众的号召性文体；称呼多为 Dear Fellow Students / Dear Friends；首段点明倡议背景；中段列出2-3条具体践行规范；尾段发出强有力的共同行动号召
经典开篇句：
  * In a concerted bid to [倡议目标，如: build a greener campus / foster academic integrity], we hereby launch this proposal to all fellow students.
  * With a view to promoting [文明倡议主题], I am writing this open letter on behalf of [协会/学生会] to advocate collective action.
正文要点展开句：
  * To translate this noble initiative into everyday reality, it is strongly recommended that we adhere to the following principles:
  * To begin with, let us consciously cultivate the habit of [举措一，如: turning off idle lights and sorting daily garbage].
  * In addition, we ought to exercise mutual supervision and politely remind peers whenever wasteful practices occur.
结语与期盼句：
  * Small deeds, when multiplied by thousands of individuals, can trigger monumental transformations.
  * Let us join hands without hesitation to make our beloved campus a cleaner, warmer, and more inspiring home!

chunks.title: 【英语一】应用文小作文高分句型与模板：推荐信 (Letter of Recommendation)
chunks.content:
【英语一 应用文句式规范 - 推荐信 (Letter of Recommendation)】
格式与考查特征：称呼 Dear Professor... / Dear Mr. Smith；首段开宗明义推荐某人/某书/某地；中段从人品、学识、能力或特色等多角度展开详实论据；尾段极力推荐并表达愿意提供补充信息
经典开篇句：
  * I am writing this letter with unreserved pleasure to recommend [人名/事物] for your esteemed [项目/职位/阅读计划].
  * Having worked closely with [人名] over the past three academic years, I have no doubt that he is an outstanding candidate for [机会].
正文要点展开句：
  * What impresses me most about [人名] is his exceptional academic curiosity coupled with relentless diligence.
  * Not only does he exhibit profound mastery in theoretical foundations, but he also possesses stellar teamwork and problem-solving abilities.
  * As for this classic masterpiece, it weaves philosophical insight with exquisite literary eloquence, offering readers an unforgettable intellectual feast.
结语与期盼句：
  * Therefore, I recommend him to you with the utmost confidence, believing that he will surpass all expectations in your program.
  * Please feel free to contact me should you require any additional references or background materials.

chunks.title: 【英语一】应用文小作文高分句型与模板：建议信 (Letter of Suggestion / Advice)
chunks.content:
【英语一 应用文句式规范 - 建议信 (Letter of Suggestion / Advice)】
格式与考查特征：语气谦逊诚恳、措辞委婉得体；首段说明写信目的并肯定既有成果；中段使用 It would be advisable to... 等虚拟或委婉句提出2-3条建设性意见；尾段期盼考虑并致谢
经典开篇句：
  * I am writing this letter to share a few humble suggestions regarding [主题，如: library management / freshman orientation].
  * While sincerely applauding the tremendous efforts made by your department, I would like to venture several constructive recommendations to further optimize [项目].
正文要点展开句：
  * In the first place, it would be highly advisable to extend the weekend opening hours so as to accommodate working students' study needs.
  * In the second place, consideration could perhaps be given to establishing an online reservation system to streamline the queuing process.
  * Last but not least, organizing periodic feedback forums would prove immensely beneficial in bridging the gap between staff and students.
结语与期盼句：
  * I would be more than delighted if my modest suggestions could be taken into thoughtful consideration.
  * Thank you for your valuable time and enduring dedication to improving our student community.

chunks.title: 【英语一】图画大作文核心母题论据库：传统文化传承与社会道德公德 (Cultural Heritage & Social Morality) - 传统文化传承与文化自信 (Cultural Heritage & Cultural Confidence)
chunks.content:
【英语一 核心母题论据语料 - 传统文化传承与社会道德公德 (Cultural Heritage & Social Morality) (传统文化传承与文化自信 (Cultural Heritage & Cultural Confidence))】
适用历年真题与话题：2023年龙舟赛与端午传承, 2022年校园传统文化讲座, 2010年文化火锅与融合, 国潮与非遗传承
核心高阶词汇与搭配：
  * cultural heritage (文化遗产): 搭配=intangible cultural heritage (非物质文化遗产)
  * cultural confidence (文化自信): 搭配=bolster cultural confidence (增强文化自信)
  * carry forward (弘扬，继承发扬): 搭配=carry forward traditional virtues (弘扬传统美德)
  * reinvigorate (注入新活力，重振): 搭配=reinvigorate ancient traditions with modern vibrancy (以现代活力重振古老传统)
  * spiritual roots (精神根脉): 搭配=cherish one's cultural and spiritual roots (珍视个人的文化与精神根脉)
  * cross-cultural communication (跨文化传播/交流): 搭配=facilitate cross-cultural communication (促进跨文化传播)
  * melting pot (大熔炉/融合): 搭配=a vibrant melting pot of diverse civilizations (多元文明的活力大熔炉)
权威名人名言与谚语：
  * "A nation that forgets its past has no future; culture is the soul of a people." —— Winston Churchill (丘吉尔) & Cultural Axiom (遗忘过去的民族没有未来；文化是一个民族的灵魂。) [应用场景: 用于论述传承民族文化遗产对国家和青年的根本意义]
  * "Civilizations become rich and vibrant through mutual exchanges and integration." —— Civilizational Dialogue Motto (文明因交流而多彩，文明因互鉴而丰富。) [应用场景: 用于文化火锅、跨文化交流与传统文化创新性转化]
  * "Fine traditions resemble towering ancient trees: only with deep roots can they sprout lush leaves in the spring of modernization." —— Metaphorical Proverb (优良传统宛如参天古木：唯有根深蒂固，方能在现代化的春天枝繁叶茂。) [应用场景: 用于阐述文化坚守与时代创新的辩证关系]
核心论证论点链：
  * Traditional heritage is by no means an obsolete relic gathering dust in museums, but a living spring that anchors national identity amidst the vortex of globalization.
    译文：传统遗产绝非在博物馆中积灰的过时陈迹，而是在全球化漩涡中维系民族身份认同的鲜活源泉。
  * By infusing creative interpretations and digital media into age-old customs, the young generation transforms timeless heritage into a trendy cultural emblem.
    译文：青年一代通过将创意阐释与数字媒介注入古老习俗，使历久弥新的文化遗产焕发为时尚的文化符号。
经典示范句式：
  * Far from being an archaic burden, traditional culture serves as the indispensable compass that guides our nation toward sustainable renewal.
  * Only when traditional values are actively revitalized and embraced by contemporary youth can the flame of civilization be passed down from generation to generation.

chunks.title: 【英语一】图画大作文核心母题论据库：传统文化传承与社会道德公德 (Cultural Heritage & Social Morality) - 孝道美德与反哺之情 (Filial Piety & Reverence for Parents)
chunks.content:
【英语一 核心母题论据语料 - 传统文化传承与社会道德公德 (Cultural Heritage & Social Morality) (孝道美德与反哺之情 (Filial Piety & Reverence for Parents))】
适用历年真题与话题：2014年相携三十年与孝敬父母, 老龄化社会与关爱老人, 家庭美德与感恩
核心高阶词汇与搭配：
  * filial piety (孝道，孝顺): 搭配=uphold the cherished virtue of filial piety (恪守珍贵的孝道美德)
  * reciprocal devotion (互爱互敬，反哺之情): 搭配=repay parents with reciprocal devotion (以反哺深情回馈父母)
  * twilight years (暮年，晚年): 搭配=support parents through their tranquil twilight years (陪伴父母度过安详晚年)
  * nurturing care (悉心照料与养育): 搭配=unrequited nurturing care (无私的抚育之恩)
  * companionship (陪伴): 搭配=provide heartfelt emotional companionship (提供由衷的情感陪伴)
  * silver-haired generation (白发一代/老年人): 搭配=address the spiritual needs of the silver-haired generation (关照银发族精神需求)
权威名人名言与谚语：
  * "Of all virtues, filial piety is the foremost." —— Ancient Chinese Wisdom (百善孝为先) (百善孝为先。) [应用场景: 用于孝敬父母主题的论点引出或结论升华]
  * "Children should never forget the age of their parents: on the one hand as an occasion for joy, and on the other as an occasion for anxiety." —— Confucius (孔子《论语》) (父母之年，不可不知也。一则以喜，一则以惧。) [应用场景: 用于论述时光飞逝与即刻尽孝的紧迫性]
核心论证论点链：
  * Parental devotion during childhood demands reciprocal gratitude when age bends the posture of those who once held our hands.
    译文：童年时父母倾注的关爱，在岁月弯曲了那双曾经牵扶我们前行的臂膀时，理应得到深情反哺。
  * Filial respect encompasses not merely material provision, but warm and sustained emotional companionship in daily life.
    译文：孝道不仅包括物质层面的赡养，更体现在日常生活中温情而持久的情感陪伴。
经典示范句式：
  * Just as parents gently supported our fledgling steps in infancy, so should grown children tenderly accompany them in their silver years.
  * True filial piety does not manifest in grandiloquent pledges, but in the attentive warmth of daily companionship and respectful listening.

chunks.title: 【英语一】图画大作文核心母题论据库：传统文化传承与社会道德公德 (Cultural Heritage & Social Morality) - 社会公德与文明素养 (Public Morality & Civic Decorum)
chunks.content:
【英语一 核心母题论据语料 - 传统文化传承与社会道德公德 (Cultural Heritage & Social Morality) (社会公德与文明素养 (Public Morality & Civic Decorum))】
适用历年真题与话题：2011年旅途乱扔垃圾, 旅游不文明现象, 公共秩序与公民道德, 诚信素养
核心高阶词汇与搭配：
  * civic decorum (文明礼貌，公民修养): 搭配=observe civic decorum in public arenas (在公共场合恪守文明素养)
  * public morality (社会公德): 搭配=undermine public morality (破坏社会公德)
  * littering (乱扔垃圾): 搭配=curb the uncivilized behavior of littering (遏制乱扔垃圾的不文明行为)
  * self-restraint (自我克制与自律): 搭配=exercise conscious self-restraint (践行自觉的自我约束)
  * harmonious society (和谐社会): 搭配=foster a harmonious and orderly society (营造和谐有序的社会)
权威名人名言与谚语：
  * "A nation's greatness is measured by how its citizens behave when no one is watching." —— Civic Ethics Principle (一个国家的伟大程度，取决于其公民在无人注视时的德行操守。) [应用场景: 用于论述自觉遵守公德与个人慎独修养]
  * "Small acts of decency, multiplied by millions of people, can transform the whole world." —— Howard Zinn (微小的文明善举，经由千百万人身体力行，便能改变整个世界。) [应用场景: 用于第三段呼吁人人从小事做起维护公德]
核心论证论点链：
  * A picturesque natural landscape is fundamentally fragile; a single piece of discarded waste is enough to tarnish the shared dignity of our ecological commons.
    译文：如画的自然景观本质上是脆弱的；一片随手丢弃的废弃物足以玷污公共生态环境的共同尊严。
  * True civilization is manifested not merely in towering skyscrapers, but in the collective commitment of citizens to respect public rules and the natural realm.
    译文：真正的文明不仅体现在鳞次栉比的摩天大楼，更体现在广大公民尊重公共规则与自然生灵的集体坚守。
经典示范句式：
  * It is disheartening to witness how sublime scenic landscapes are desecrated by thoughtless littering and moral indifference.
  * Only when rigorous institutional penalties combine with heightened civic awareness can we root out the scourge of uncivilized misconduct.

chunks.title: 【英语一】图画大作文核心母题论据库：人与自然、生态文明与宜居城市 (Ecology, Environment & Urban Habitat) - 人与自然和谐共生与宜居城市 (Coexistence with Nature & Livable Cities)
chunks.content:
【英语一 核心母题论据语料 - 人与自然、生态文明与宜居城市 (Ecology, Environment & Urban Habitat) (人与自然和谐共生与宜居城市 (Coexistence with Nature & Livable Cities))】
适用历年真题与话题：2024年城市公园与宜居生活, 2011年湖泊旅游乱扔垃圾, 生态文明建设, 绿色低碳
核心高阶词汇与搭配：
  * ecological civilization (生态文明): 搭配=advance the construction of ecological civilization (推进生态文明建设)
  * harmonious coexistence (和谐共生): 搭配=strive for harmonious coexistence between humans and nature (追求人与自然和谐共生)
  * pocket park (口袋公园/微型公园): 搭配=the proliferation of accessible pocket parks (便民口袋公园的普及)
  * livability (适居性，宜居度): 搭配=enhance urban livability and citizen contentment (提高城市宜居度和市民满意度)
  * green footprint (绿色足迹/低碳 footprint): 搭配=expand green ecological footprints (扩大绿色生态足迹)
  * sustainable development (可持续发展): 搭配=chart a course of sustainable green development (开辟可持续绿色发展道路)
权威名人名言与谚语：
  * "Lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets." —— Xi Jinping (绿色发展理念：绿水青山就是金山银山) (绿水青山就是金山银山。) [应用场景: 用于中国生态文明建设、人与自然关系论证]
  * "Nature does not need people; people need nature." —— Conservation International Motto (大自然不需要人类；人类却离不开大自然。) [应用场景: 用于论述保护生态环境归根到底是在守护人类自身的生存家园]
核心论证论点链：
  * Urban modernization is measured not merely by towering concrete skyscrapers, but by the accessible greenery that allows citizens to breathe fresh air and unwind within walking distance.
    译文：城市现代化的衡量标尺不仅在于林立的钢筋水泥摩天楼，更在于步行可达的葱郁绿意让市民得以呼吸新鲜空气、纾解身心。
  * Sacrificing environmental sustainability for ephemeral economic gain is an act of draining the pond to catch all the fish, leaving irreparable debts for posterity.
    译文：以牺牲环境可持续性为代价换取短暂经济利益无异于竭泽而渔，将给子孙后代留下难以弥补的生态亏欠。
经典示范句式：
  * The increasing presence of pocket parks and urban green belts vividly mirrors our societal shift from purely pursuing GDP growth to prioritizing human-centric well-being.
  * Only when environmental preservation is deeply woven into the fabric of urban planning can modern metropolises flourish as hospitable habitats for both body and soul.

chunks.title: 【英语一】图画大作文核心母题论据库：家庭教育与青年成长担当 (Family Education & Youth Growth) - 言传身教与榜样力量 (Leading by Example & Parental Role Modeling)
chunks.content:
【英语一 核心母题论据语料 - 家庭教育与青年成长担当 (Family Education & Youth Growth) (言传身教与榜样力量 (Leading by Example & Parental Role Modeling))】
适用历年真题与话题：2016年父亲看电视与陪伴读书, 家庭教育方式, 言行一致, 偶像与示范
核心高阶词汇与搭配：
  * lead by example (以身作则，言传身教): 搭配=parents should lead by example rather than by coercion (父母应当以身作则而非施加强迫)
  * role model (榜样，楷模): 搭配=serve as an inspiring role model (树立令人奋进的榜样)
  * preaching (空洞说教): 搭配=empty verbal preaching (空洞的言语说教)
  * hypocritical (虚伪的，言行不一的): 搭配=avoid hypocritical double standards (避免双重标准的言行不一)
  * subtle influence (潜移默化的影响): 搭配=exert a profound and subtle influence (施加深远而潜移默化的影响)
  * companionship (良性陪伴): 搭配=constructive educational companionship (建设性的教育陪伴)
权威名人名言与谚语：
  * "Example is not the main thing in influencing others; it is the only thing." —— Albert Schweitzer (阿尔伯特·史怀哲，诺贝尔和平奖得主) (榜样并非影响他人的主要手段，它是唯一的手段。) [应用场景: 2016年家庭教育题最具杀伤力的核心名言]
  * "Children have never been very good at listening to their elders, but they have never failed to imitate them." —— James Baldwin (詹姆斯·鲍德温) (孩子们从来不善于听从长辈的说教，但在模仿长辈方面却从未失手。) [应用场景: 用于论述父母一举一动对子女的深刻塑造]
核心论证论点链：
  * Parental commands delivered from a comfortable sofa invariably fall on deaf ears, while a quiet habit of reading cultivated alongside a child speaks louder than thousands of reprimands.
    译文：坐在安乐沙发上发号施令的家长往往换来孩子的充耳不闻，而在孩子身旁静心伴读的习惯却远胜千言万语的训诫。
  * Effective parenting is not an exercise of authoritarian power, but an art of mutual growth where parents inspire virtues through their own conduct.
    译文：卓有成效的家庭教育绝非威权权力的施展，而是一门共同成长的艺术——父母通过自身躬行来启发孩子的美德。
经典示范句式：
  * Actions speak incomparably louder than words: what children absorb most deeply is not what parents lecture, but what parents embody in daily conduct.
  * It is hypocrisy of the worst kind to demand rigorous academic diligence from one's offspring while indulging oneself in ceaseless entertainment.

chunks.title: 【英语一】图画大作文核心母题论据库：家庭教育与青年成长担当 (Family Education & Youth Growth) - 青年抉择与身心全面发展 (Youth Choices & Holistic Wellbeing)
chunks.content:
【英语一 核心母题论据语料 - 家庭教育与青年成长担当 (Family Education & Youth Growth) (青年抉择与身心全面发展 (Youth Choices & Holistic Wellbeing))】
适用历年真题与话题：2013年毕业十字路口, 2021年学业与跑步鞋, 身心平衡, 职业规划
核心高阶词汇与搭配：
  * crossroads (人生的十字路口): 搭配=stand at the pivotal crossroads of life (伫立于人生的关键十字路口)
  * holistic development (全面发展): 搭配=strive for holistic intellectual and physical development (追求德智体全面发展)
  * self-actualization (自我实现): 搭配=pursue authentic self-actualization (追求真实的自我实现)
  * sound mind in a sound body (健全的精神寓于健康的体魄): 搭配=foster a sound mind in a sound body (培育身心健全的自我)
  * sober rationality (清醒的理性): 搭配=make choices with sober rationality (保持清醒理性作出抉择)
权威名人名言与谚语：
  * "A sound mind in a sound body is a short but full description of a happy state in this world." —— John Locke (约翰·洛克) (健全的精神寓于健康的身体，是对世间幸福状态简明而完整的描摹。) [应用场景: 用于2021年强身健体与学业平衡大作文]
  * "It is not in the stars to hold our destiny but in ourselves." —— William Shakespeare (莎士比亚) (决定我们命运的并非苍穹星宿，而是我们自身。) [应用场景: 用于青年自主抉择与奋发图强]
核心论证论点链：
  * Academic distinction without robust physical vitality is akin to a skyscraper erected on quicksand; physical wellness forms the ultimate foundation of enduring intellect.
    译文：缺乏强健体魄支撑的学术卓越宛如建在流沙上的摩天大厦；身体健康才是持久智慧的坚实根基。
  * When navigating perplexing career crossroads, young graduates must balance societal demands with inner passion, anchoring decisions on clear self-awareness rather than blind conformity.
    译文：在纷繁迷茫的职业十字路口前，青年学子必须兼顾社会需求与内心热情，基于清醒的自我认知而非盲目随波逐流作出抉择。
经典示范句式：
  * Far from mutually exclusive rivals, vigorous physical exercise and arduous academic pursuit are mutually reinforcing partners on the road to success.
  * Rather than being paralyzed by the uncertainty of diverse career avenues, graduates should muster courage, assess realistic aptitudes, and stride forward with conviction.
